sample_source: The proteins identified by MS in Co-IP experiments using anti-NLRC5 or IgG antibody in NMCMs are provided in Supplementary Data 1 and 2.
age: NMCMs were isolated from the hearts of 1-day-old neonatal ICR mice
cell_line: The HEK-293T cell line (batch number: 230330F101), and AC16 cell line (batch number: 240531X201) were obtained from Haixing Bioscience (Suzhou, China).
sex: Only male mice were utilized in these in vivo studies
strain: eight-week-old male Institute of Cancer Research (ICR) mice were sourced from the Animal Core Facility of Nanjing Medical University (Nanjing, China).
